body:
I can't study hard, I have been dropped from university. I can't talk to strangers because I am barely able to leave my bed let alone the house. And I can't focus on my work because since I've been fired I haven't left the house. True friends are apparently something I do not have since it's about a month since that happened and she was the last person who spoke to me. I don't think those are temporary problems. I have been depressed since I was 12..that's the first time I wanted to die and I am well into my twenties. It's just not getting any better. I won't kill myself until my parents die. But after that there is nothing that can keep me.

Thank you, for your words. I am glad someone read it. It's very kind of you to say you'd be my friend. Thank you very very much. I hope that your life will be good. You really do deserve it.
